cohort: The study included 103 pregnancies in 97 individuals admitted for DKA at a single Midwestern academic medical center over a 10-year period (2012-2021).
finding: Diabetic ketoacidosis occurred predominantly in pregnancies affected by type 1 diabetes, with individuals with type 1 diabetes presenting with greater DKA severity but achieving clinical resolution more rapidly than those with type 2 diabetes.
mod_finding: The cesarean delivery rate for pregnancies complicated by DKA was 71.9%.
gest_age: Median gestational age at admission was 29 3/7 weeks, and median gestational age at delivery was 34 6/7 weeks (interquartile range 33 2/7-36 3/7 weeks).
